prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Pearland, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1408; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were involved in recently in Pearland. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision happened?

A: I was driving north on a two-lane road, heading to the store. It was late afternoon and the road was pretty clear.

Q: What happened right before the impact?

A: A car coming the other way drifted into my lane as it went around a slight curve. I braked and turned a little to the right, but we still hit nearly head-on. It wasn't a hard hit, more like a jolt.

Q: What was your speed at the time, as best you recall?

A: I'd say around thirty miles an hour. I wasn't going fast.

Q: Did your airbags deploy, or did you have to be taken from the scene?

A: No airbags went off. I got out of the car on my own and sat on the curb until the police arrived.

Q: Did you seek medical attention afterward?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that evening. They said I had a neck strain and gave me some medication and a soft collar.

Q: Are you currently experiencing any symptoms?

A: Yes, my neck is stiff, especially when I turn my head to the left, and I get some tightness across my shoulders by the end of the day.

Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?

A: No, nothing that required treatment before this.

Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: Just that I'm still going to physical therapy and I'm hoping to get back to normal soon.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
